model.block: out = gelu(mlp(gelu(spectral + local)) + gate * in); layer 4 has no gelu
model.lifting: P: 1x1 conv 3->64, gelu, 1x1 conv 64->32; input channels [a, x=i/H, y=j/W]
model.projection: Q: 1x1 conv 32->64, gelu, 1x1 conv 64->1; output * y_std + y_mean

encoding.atlas: q = clip(round(v/m*127)+128, 1, 255); v = (q-128)/127*m; 8 cols x 4 rows of 64x64, channel c at row c//8, col c%8
encoding.io: float32 LE [3, res, res]: input a, target u, prediction (physical units)
encoding.spectra: float32 LE [4 layers, 3, 64, 64]: kind 0 layer input, 1 after truncation (-30 = discarded), 2 spectral path output; log10 sum_c |F|^2 with norm=forward, (0,0) at [32,32]
encoding.weights: float16 LE flat; complex tensors interleaved (re, im); offsets in elements

problem.name: Navier-Stokes
problem.source: Zenodo 12825163: 2-D incompressible Navier-Stokes on the torus, Re 500, generated at 1024x1024 by a classical solver and shipped at 128x128. The 64 and 32 grids are point subsamples of 128.

stats.averaging_note: Averages and channel rankings use the 4 farthest-point samples (0, 158, 138, 24).
